title: Ice And Fire-Expanded pack
description: This pack uses the ice and fire mod along with dragon mounts and biomes we've gone to make an interactive world with lots of things to do
body:
- Step into a living, breathing ecosystem where the line between myth and reality blurs. This curated experience seamlessly integrates the legendary ferocity of Ice and Fire with the diverse wildlife of Naturalist and Alex’s Mobs, creating a world that feels truly inhabited. Whether you are tracking a rogue Griffin through a dense Biomes O' Plenty forest or stumbling upon a mysterious traveler powered by Easy NPC, every journey tells a story.

- Harness the arcane with a deep, integrated magic system that allows you to bend the elements to your will or protect your homestead from the shadows. With Dragon Mounts providing mastery over the skies and Corpse ensuring your hard-earned progress is never truly lost, the world is as forgiving as it is dangerous. Prepare for an interactive odyssey where your influence reshapes the landscape and your mastery of both beast and spell defines your legacy.

This pack uses the ice and fire mod along with dragon mounts and biomes we've gone to make an interactive world with lots of things to do, it includes mods like Alexs Mod, Naturalist, Corpse, Easy Npc and a lot more mods this pack also adds magic into the world 

- there is a offical minecraft server of this pack created by the owner (https://discord.gg/eRV2ZNV4Ve)
